### What Makes Faith Fall Apart
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-april-16-2020.html
Passage: Ezekiel 47:8-9
Points:
- Devastating trauma and heartbreak often tempt people to believe that healing and restoration are impossible.
- In Ezekiel's vision, a small trickle of water from the temple becomes a deep river that turns the lifeless Dead Sea fresh.
- This miraculous transformation offers a vivid picture of God's ultimate plan to renew and redeem a broken world.
- Through Christ, believers have immediate access to living water that revives weary hearts from mere survival into spiritual vitality.
- Faith falters not simply from doubt, but from certainty that a situation is beyond God's power to transform.

### Alive
Author: Rachel Olsen
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-july-2-2009-11605509.html
Passage: Ezekiel 47:9a
Points:
- Unfinished responsibilities and daily demands can easily leave a person feeling overwhelmed, drained, and spiritually numb.
- Ezekiel witnessed a life-giving stream originating at the temple altar that expanded into a vast river where everything flourishes.
- God's living water carries the power to cleanse, heal, and bring vitality to whatever it touches.
- Christians are challenged to move past merely dipping their toes into God's presence and fully immerse their daily walk in Him.
